_comment: Canonical Trendlyne MCP parameter tokens for WealthOS F1-F7 filter fields. Verified 2026-10-18.

_tools.get_stock_parameter_values: up to 10 stocks, 50 metrics per call
_tools.get_ownership_deals_insider_sast: shareholding, bulk/block deals, SAST, insider trades per stock
_tools.get_overview_news_corp_events: news and corporate events per stock
_tools.get_document_search_results: annual reports, concall transcripts, investor presentations

notes.DII: Trendlyne uses 'instihold' for total institutional (FII+DII). DII = instihold - fiihold. MF is a subset of DII tracked via 'mfhold'.
notes.pledge_basis: prompledge is % of promoter shares pledged (not total shares). Store as-is; display context clarifies.
notes.cfo_ebitda_quarterly: cfoq and ebitdaq return None for diversified conglomerates (Reliance) and banks (HDFCBANK). Annual tokens (cfoa/ebitdaa) may have better coverage.
notes.pat_8q_check: Use get_ownership_deals_insider_sast with type=shareholding for historical quarterly PAT; or call reportedpatq for current + historical via separate API.
